$comment: Curated corrections applied by scripts/seed_from_research.py to research names whose name_la or name_en carries editorial text (variants, remarks, '(Latin unverified)'). Keyed by research key and index into the research body's names[]. research_name_la / research_name_en must match the research exactly (a guard). name_la is the clean form, or null when no Latin name is attested; nothing is reconstructed. Variants go to aliases [{name, lang}], remarks to the name's note. verified may only be set to false (a downgrade).

entries.research_name_en: Congregation of the Holy Office (Supreme Sacred Congregation of the Holy Office)

aliases.name: Supreme Sacred Congregation of the Holy Office

entries.note: Seeding (seed/name_fixes.json): the research gives the name with its AAS-heading form in parentheses ('Congregatio Sancti Officii (Suprema Sacra Congregatio S. Officii)'; English 'Congregation of the Holy Office (Supreme Sacred Congregation of the Holy Office)'). The parenthesised forms are aliases.
